The apartment

A 94 sqm sub-penthouse on the twenty-fourth floor of Royal Palms.

Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and one secure car space with intercom access. The main bedroom has an ensuite, built-in robes and its own ocean-facing balcony. The second bedroom has built-in robes. Living and dining are open plan and run out to the main balcony.

The kitchen has stone benchtops and a herringbone splashback. The apartment faces north, along the coastline toward the Surfers Paradise skyline. There is no building site between this balcony and the water.

Royal Palms sits on the beach side of the Gold Coast Highway, directly opposite Palm Beach Parklands, with a 33-metre lagoon pool, spa, steam room, gymnasium and full-size tennis court on title.

The position

Cross the road and you are on the sand.

Palm Beach is the quiet end of the Gold Coast that people move to once they have stopped wanting the noise of the northern strip. The parklands opposite run the length of the beach, Currumbin Alley is a few minutes south, and the airport is close enough for a Sydney or Melbourne owner to be here for a weekend without it being a project.

Bidding

What buying at auction requires.

In Queensland an auction sale is unconditional. The successful bidder signs the contract and pays the deposit on the day. There is no cooling-off period and no finance clause, which is why the work happens before Friday 9 October rather than after it.

None of that is meant to put you off. It is the reason a prepared buyer wins this apartment and an unprepared one watches it go. Call me early and I will walk you through the contract and the body corporate records myself.

  1. Get the contract and body corporate records. Ask me and they are with you the same day, along with the building disclosure statement.
  2. Have your solicitor review them. Before auction day, not after. Any special conditions have to be negotiated in advance.
  3. Confirm your finance in writing. Unconditional approval, or funds available. There is no finance clause to fall back on.
  4. Arrange your deposit. Payable on the day the hammer falls.
  5. Register to bid. Identification required. Phone and proxy bidding available if you cannot attend — arrange it the week before.
